name: Paseo Colorado
description: Paseo Colorado is an upscale open-air lifestyle center located in the heart of historic Old Pasadena, featuring a distinctive blend of retail, dining, entertainment, and residential components. Originally opened in 2001 on the former site of the Pasadena Plaza, this urban mixed-use development spans multiple city blocks and offers a pedestrian-friendly shopping experience with Spanish-colonial inspired architecture. The center serves as a gateway to Pasadena's vibrant downtown district, combining national retailers with local boutiques and restaurants.
demographics: Paseo Colorado attracts an affluent, educated demographic typical of Pasadena's urban core, with visitors ranging from young professionals to established families with median household incomes exceeding the regional average. The trade area serves Old Pasadena's upscale residential neighborhoods and draws tourists visiting the historic downtown district. Shoppers tend to favor experiential retail, dining, and entertainment options, with strong spending patterns in lifestyle categories and premium casual dining.
summary: Paseo Colorado is an upscale open-air lifestyle center in downtown Pasadena combining retail, dining, and entertainment in a mixed-use urban environment.
